findings.title: Khubr as a receptive catchment
findings.claim: Exploratorily within the declared pericope, the missing experiential knowledge can be pictured as a receptive catchment in which scattered, moving signs collect before comprehensive understanding forms.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun خُبْرًا carries the supplied soft, low, water-gathering land branch, while 18:60 supplies joining at the meeting place and 18:61 supplies water moving through a channel. Their contact changes knowledge from an abstract stock one either has or lacks into a process in which dispersed signs gather into a graspable whole.
findings.reader_payoff: The question's unknown gains a spatial image: understanding may need a low place where what is scattered can collect before the whole can be held.
findings.containment: The ordinary knowledge reading of خُبْرًا remains primary and recoverable. This is an attributed exploratory spatial metaphor; the supplied root_000372/B003 donkey-and-herd collocation is excluded because its form-bound carrier is absent, and the remaining unresolved branch roles are not given invented glosses.
